page.layout: One page of verse in two columns of lines, set as stanzas, with a few italic lines. Running head at the top right. Page number at the top left. Two lines of verse run to the right edge and a short line of verse sits at the bottom right, partly cut off by the scan edge. No margin notes.

l.i: Hic alba florent Lilia cum rosa.

page.notes: Transcription is partly uncertain at the scan edges. The French lines, the line beginning "Hic suauitates" and the word "Thimiaque" are read from a slightly blurred print. The short line "Mira" at the lower right is cut off by the right edge of the scan. The word "Coloßos" is printed as shown, with a long-s form, and "theatris" is as printed. Where the page is cut by the right edge, the line "regarde & fe" continues beyond the scan and is marked as cut off. Some letters are obscured by ink at the left margin and are not marked, as they are readable.
